text_block_list.text: It was like I was trapped in a box.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Everything around me was dark, and I
couldn't
see a thing. That's not how I
want to run.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Next time, we're going to break out of that box.
Do you feel like you want to quit?

text_block_list.text: Yes. Next time, I'll run my way.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Quite the opposite, actually. I won't
allow myself
to brood endlessly.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I want to step back onto the track as
soon as
possible... Next time, I'm getting
to the front.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I'll never give up the lead again.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
